_what: Words a deletion of the account answers with (src/account/erase.rs; old trillion src/account-routes.mjs:859-871 'account/delete'). `{at}` is filled in with a time, `{step}` with a step's name; nothing else is.
being_deleted: Your account is being deleted. Ask again to go on; nothing else of the account answers until it is done.
waits: The deletion's last step failed; it tries again after {at}.
already_deleted: This account's deletion is already complete.
not_begun: No deletion of this account has begun.
redriven: The deletion may try again now.
not_redriven: The deletion is not waiting, so nothing changed.
